verdict.conclusion: No unresolved funds-flow, recipient-quote, or declaration defect found in the reviewed candidate. The added quote-output/direct-output paths have current issued-Family historical execution evidence in both directions. The harness caller-requirement defect is confirmed and regressed successfully on the identical Ready09/prices inputs.

protocolAndCurrentWiring.protocol: Input-first buyGem(recipient,inputStable) / sellGem(recipient,inputGem); payer is msg.sender, output net is sent to recipient and fee separately to treasury; no deferred payment/callback.
protocolAndCurrentWiring.recipientPreview: preview uses actual recipient for whitelist/fees. Quote program patches current r0 input and passes the same recipient as swap; executor remains payer/caller.
protocolAndCurrentWiring.treasuryReceiver: Runtime preparation returns net+fee when treasury==recipient; receipt is measured separately from the ABI net return.
protocolAndCurrentWiring.treasuryPayer: The fresh identity/default Exact exclusion remains unchanged. In a previously issued direct program with mutated treasury==payer and external receiver, nonzero fee output left at payer fails the exact output/inventory guard; zero-fee synthetic case succeeds. This does not prove fresh admission for treasury==payer.
protocolAndCurrentWiring.limits: Transaction-local readonly preflight checks positive input/output, paused, gross reserves, input normalized to WAD, zero-disabled per-transaction cap and remaining block capacity. Input balance and approval are checked at execution; they are not required during prefunding preparation.
protocolAndCurrentWiring.defaultBytes: Established default four-call runtime program is compared byte-for-byte in the passing PSV test; default Exact/quoted interfaces and their source/evidence binding remain unchanged. Old default evidence is not invalidated because the new external-recipient path needed additional execution.
protocolAndCurrentWiring.sharedComposition: Prefix quote receiver is executor for intermediates and actual debt receiver for the penultimate leg. Aqua taker receiver is aligned; CP UniV2 validates receiver without changing formula; opaque UniV2 keeps executor-only quoting. These shared changes have code/model/ABI compatibility coverage, not new historical multi-Family execution coverage.

checkedWithoutPassFlags: All 48 outcomes resolve with correct source/generation and matching issued trusted/evidence rows.
All 32 positives show exact payer input debit and equal vault input credit, plus exact output vault debit and intended recipient credit.

All 16 recipient positives preserve payer pre-existing output and receiver input; actor old input remains 101 raw units, actor old output is seeded to expected credit+103, and actor native is seeded to 17 wei with observed delta zero.
Token observation set is complete for both tokens across deduplicated payer/vault/recipient/treasury accounts, including the treasury==recipient case.

All 32 positives match Swap sender, recipient, input/output tokens, amountIn, net amountOut and fee, and Transfer amounts. Approval logs are [0,input,0], with a final actual readonly allowance==0 assertion in the executed calldata.
Every one of 16 prepared quotes has only static external calls, is invoked in a transitive readonly child, and the identical quote program is also the first readonly child inside direct execution.
Each quote preview receiver matches its swap receiver in raw ABI bytes, r0 patches the actual amount, and the asserted quote result equals the recipient receipt.

Eight no-input negatives retain exactly the same call object/calldata as their positive control, changing input balance to zero only. Eight forced-revert negatives retain the entire successful script prefix and append an always-failing equality guard.
historicalExecution.negativeQualification: All 16 negatives have completion=reverted-as-declared and empty token/native/log arrays. The strict transport deliberately omits effects on declared reverts, so emptiness is not independent measured rollback or raw stateDiff evidence.
historicalExecution.nativeRecipientQualification: Historical transport observes native balance of caller/executor only. External recipient native delta is not present in these historical records; no claim that historical receiver native was measured.
historicalExecution.recipientOldInventoryQualification: Historical deltas protect the actual receiver balances present at N, but no nonzero receiver pre-balance amount is retained in this evidence. Explicit nonzero receiver token/native inventory is exercised in synthetic EVM09.

actualRuntimeSyntheticEvm.deploymentMeaning: Saved real PSV proxy/implementation runtime with relocated __self words; new initialized synthetic storage, synthetic ERC20s and test actors. No claim of historical nonzero state or mainnet execution.

Treasury==receiver credits gross net+fee and distinct treasury actually receives fee.
Treasury==payer positive-fee split output reverts and zero-fee case succeeds.
Positive input/output, gross reserve equality/shortage, pause, and cross-decimal fee floors (18→6 and 6→18).
Inclusive per-transaction/block caps, sequential capacity exhaustion, and next-block reset.
Input zero debit, one-unit under/over debit, false approval, short output and wrong output recipient revert.

actualRuntimeSyntheticEvm.testIndependence: Expected-revert applies only to bot execution; balance/allowance/capacity assertions occur afterward. Removing the emitted exact-debit/receipt guards would let the controlled faulty token operation succeed and fail the expected-revert test.

harnessDefect09To10.regression10: 24 historical sample groups / 48 executed simulations completed, all saved-data checks passed. Ready09 was reused; no second Ready run is needed for this harness-only declaration correction.
